title: XtraFps
description: A performence modpack that rapidly increases frame rates aswell as other optimisations
body:
XtraFPS is a lightweight Minecraft performance modpack made for one purpose:
👉 to squeeze every last frame out of your game without ruining vanilla vibes.

No unnecessary mods. No clutter. Just pure speed.

Whether your PC is low-end or high-end, XtraFPS reduces stutters, speeds up world loading, and boosts FPS using smart optimization mods (like Sodium/Lithium/FerriteCore/Starlight depending on your version). It keeps vanilla gameplay exactly the same — just way smoother.

✨ Features

🚀 Massive FPS boost — in many cases +50% to +300% depending on your hardware.

⚡ Faster loading times — jump into worlds noticeably quicker.

🌍 Reduced lag spikes — smoother chunk loading & less stutter when exploring.

🔧 No gameplay changes — everything feels like vanilla, just faster.

🧠 Low RAM friendly — optimized for budget PCs and laptops.

[Contains No unnecessary mods and pvp advantage modifications]

✔ compatible with vanilla servers
✔ people who want higher FPS
✔ low-end laptop users
✔ players who prefer vanilla gameplay without shaders or heavy mods

Why XtraFPS?

Because Minecraft should feel smooth — no matter what hardware you have.

More frames. Less lag. Better vibes.
